race.comment: BASSETT HOUND (9) stamped his authority on resumption when scoring from the back with relative ease, winning by 0.5L. This looks an easier race on paper and he remains down in the weights. Looks a Pinnacles contender and he can keep his winning streak alive. DEVINE BELIEF (4) was 100-1 behind BASSETT HOUND last start where he got onto the back of the winner and ended up 0.8L away. Likely to get back in the run again and Cooper's claim comes in handy. Can feature in the finish again. KINGS COURT (7) can find the front from an inside draw as he did last start where he ended up 2.6L off the winner. Will give them something to chase. SANTANOVA (5) is first-up and has never missed the placings when fresh. Drawn well and won't be far away. GINNIVAN (1) draws the inside and can be in this for a long way.
